toolchain: GitHub Actions windows-2025, MSVC (TheMrMilchmann/setup-msvc-dev@v4, x64), CMake + Ninja; cibuildwheel + delvewheel
build_commands: 7z x geos-3.14.1.tar.bz2 && 7z x geos-3.14.1.tar && cd geos-3.14.1
cmake -GNinja -D CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release -D BUILD_SHARED_LIBS=ON -D CMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX=%GEOS_INSTALL% -D BUILD_TESTING=OFF -S . -B build
delvewheel copies geos.dll / geos_c.dll into shapely.libs with hashed names
correspondence: Both shipped GEOS DLLs are byte-identical to the shapely 2.2.0 cp313 win_amd64 wheel members and report 3.14.1; shapely 2.2.0's release workflow builds GEOS 3.14.1 from the retained download.osgeo.org tarball (same bytes as the Mac record) with the retained script.
